Final SQL / answer

WITH maxima AS (
    SELECT MAX(g) AS games_played,
           MAX(CASE WHEN typeof(r) IN ('integer', 'real') THEN r END) AS runs,
           MAX(CASE WHEN typeof(h) IN ('integer', 'real') THEN h END) AS hits,
           MAX(CASE WHEN typeof(hr) IN ('integer', 'real') THEN hr END) AS home_runs
    FROM main.batting
),
leaders AS (
    SELECT 1 AS stat_order, 'Games played' AS statistic, b.player_id, b.g AS score_value
    FROM main.batting AS b
    JOIN maxima AS m ON b.g = m.games_played
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, 'Runs', b.player_id, b.r
    FROM main.batting AS b
    JOIN maxima AS m ON b.r = m.runs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, 'Hits', b.player_id, b.h
    FROM main.batting AS b
    JOIN maxima AS m ON b.h = m.hits
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 4, 'Home runs', b.player_id, b.hr
    FROM main.batting AS b
    JOIN maxima AS m ON b.hr = m.home_runs
)
SELECT p.name_given, l.statistic, l.score_value
FROM leaders AS l
JOIN main.player AS p ON p.player_id = l.player_id
ORDER BY l.stat_order, p.name_given, l.player_id
LIMIT -1

Final SQL / answer

WITH maxima AS (
    SELECT MAX(g) AS games,
           MAX(NULLIF(r, '')) AS runs,
           MAX(NULLIF(h, '')) AS hits,
           MAX(NULLIF(hr, '')) AS home_runs
    FROM main.batting
),
leaders AS (
    SELECT b.player_id, 'Games played' AS statistic, b.g AS score
    FROM main.batting AS b JOIN maxima AS m ON b.g = m.games
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.player_id, 'Runs', b.r
    FROM main.batting AS b JOIN maxima AS m ON b.r = m.runs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.player_id, 'Hits', b.h
    FROM main.batting AS b JOIN maxima AS m ON b.h = m.hits
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.player_id, 'Home runs', b.hr
    FROM main.batting AS b JOIN maxima AS m ON b.hr = m.home_runs
)
SELECT l.statistic, p.name_given, l.score
FROM leaders AS l
JOIN main.player AS p ON p.player_id = l.player_id
ORDER BY CASE l.statistic
             WHEN 'Games played' THEN 1
             WHEN 'Runs' THEN 2
             WHEN 'Hits' THEN 3
             WHEN 'Home runs' THEN 4
         END, p.name_given
LIMIT 1000

Final SQL / answer

WITH role_counts AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           role,
           SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS total_matches_played,
           RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY player_id
               ORDER BY role IS NULL, COUNT(*) DESC
           ) AS role_rank
    FROM main.player_match
    GROUP BY player_id, role
),
appearances AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           GROUP_CONCAT(role, ', ') AS most_frequent_role,
           MAX(total_matches_played) AS total_matches_played
    FROM (
        SELECT player_id, role, total_matches_played
        FROM role_counts
        WHERE role_rank = 1
        ORDER BY player_id, role
    )
    GROUP BY player_id
),
batting_by_match AS (
    SELECT b.striker AS player_id,
           b.match_id,
           SUM(s.runs_scored) AS runs_scored,
           COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
),
batting_career AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs_scored,
           MAX(runs_scored) AS highest_score,
           SUM(runs_scored >= 30) AS matches_with_30_plus,
           SUM(runs_scored >= 50) AS matches_with_50_plus,
           SUM(runs_scored >= 100) AS matches_with_100_plus,
           SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls_faced
    FROM batting_by_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out AS player_id,
           COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals
    FROM main.wicket_taken
    WHERE kind_out <> 'retired hurt'
    GROUP BY player_out
),
bowling_by_match AS (
    SELECT b.bowler AS player_id,
           b.match_id,
           SUM(COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0)) AS runs_given,
           -- Count recorded deliveries for economy while ignoring the extra-runs data.
           COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN w.kind_out IN (
               'bowled', 'caught', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket', 'lbw', 'stumped'
           ) THEN 1 END) AS wickets_taken
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    LEFT JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id
),
bowling_career AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           wickets_taken || '-' || runs_given AS best_bowling_performance,
           SUM(wickets_taken) OVER player_matches AS total_wickets_taken,
           SUM(runs_given) OVER player_matches AS total_runs_given,
           SUM(balls_bowled) OVER player_matches AS total_balls_bowled,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY player_id
               ORDER BY wickets_taken DESC, runs_given, match_id
           ) AS performance_rank
    FROM bowling_by_match
    WINDOW player_matches AS (PARTITION BY player_id)
)
SELECT p.player_id,
       p.player_name,
       a.most_frequent_role,
       p.batting_hand,
       p.bowling_skill,
       COALESCE(bt.total_runs_scored, 0) AS total_runs_scored,
       COALESCE(a.total_matches_played, 0) AS total_matches_played,
       COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS total_dismissals,
       1.0 * COALESCE(bt.total_runs_scored, 0) / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS batting_average,
       bt.highest_score,
       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_30_plus, 0) AS matches_with_30_plus,
       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_50_plus, 0) AS matches_with_50_plus,
       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_100_plus, 0) AS matches_with_100_plus,
       COALESCE(bt.total_balls_faced, 0) AS total_balls_faced,
       100.0 * bt.total_runs_scored / NULLIF(bt.total_balls_faced, 0) AS strike_rate,
       COALESCE(bw.total_wickets_taken, 0) AS total_wickets_taken,
       6.0 * bw.total_runs_given / NULLIF(bw.total_balls_bowled, 0) AS economy_rate,
       bw.best_bowling_performance
FROM main.player AS p
LEFT JOIN appearances AS a ON a.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN batting_career AS bt ON bt.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals AS d ON d.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowling_career AS bw ON bw.player_id = p.player_id AND bw.performance_rank = 1

      "sql": "WITH role_counts AS (\n  SELECT player_id, role, COUNT(*) AS matches\n  FROM main.player_match\n  WHERE role IS NOT NULL\n  GROUP BY player_id, role\n),\nrole_ranks AS (\n  SELECT RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY matches DESC) AS role_rank, player_id\n  FROM role_counts\n),\ndelivery_checks AS (\n  SELECT COUNT(*) AS deliveries,\n         SUM(b.striker IS NULL) AS missing_striker,\n         SUM(b.bowler IS NULL) AS missing_bowler,\n         SUM(s.match_id IS NULL) AS missing_score_row,\n         SUM(s.match_id IS NOT NULL AND s.runs_scored IS NULL) AS null_scores\n  FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b\n  LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)\n)\nSELECT 'dismissal_kind' AS check_name, COALESCE(w.kind_out, '<NULL>') AS category,\n       COUNT(*) AS records,\n       SUM(b.match_id IS NULL) AS unmatched_deliveries,\n       SUM(w.player_out IS NULL) AS missing_player\nFROM main.wicket_taken AS w\nLEFT JOIN main.ball_by_ball AS b USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)\nGROUP BY w.kind_out\nUNION ALL SELECT 'role', COALESCE(role, '<NULL>'), COUNT(*), NULL, NULL FROM main.player_match GROUP BY role\nUNION ALL SELECT 'tied_top_role', NULL, COUNT(*), NULL, NULL\n  FROM (SELECT player_id FROM role_ranks WHERE role_rank = 1 GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)\nUNION ALL SELECT 'players', NULL, COUNT(*), NULL, NULL FROM main.player\nUNION ALL SELECT 'players_without_match', NULL, COUNT(*), NULL, NULL\n  FROM main.player AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main.player_match AS pm WHERE pm.player_id = p.player_id)\nUNION ALL SELECT 'deliveries', NULL, deliveries, missing_striker, missing_bowler FROM delivery_checks\nUNION ALL SELECT 'scores', NULL, missing_score_row, null_scores, NULL FROM delivery_checks;"
    },

      "sql": "WITH role_counts AS (\n    SELECT player_id,\n           role,\n           SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS total_matches_played,\n           RANK() OVER (\n               PARTITION BY player_id\n               ORDER BY role IS NULL, COUNT(*) DESC\n           ) AS role_rank\n    FROM main.player_match\n    GROUP BY player_id, role\n),\nappearances AS (\n    SELECT player_id,\n           GROUP_CONCAT(role, ', ') AS most_frequent_role,\n           MAX(total_matches_played) AS total_matches_played\n    FROM (\n        SELECT player_id, role, total_matches_played\n        FROM role_counts\n        WHERE role_rank = 1\n        ORDER BY player_id, role\n    )\n    GROUP BY player_id\n),\nbatting_by_match AS (\n    SELECT b.striker AS player_id,\n           b.match_id,\n           SUM(s.runs_scored) AS runs_scored,\n           COUNT(*) AS balls_faced\n    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b\n    JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)\n    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id\n),\nbatting_career AS (\n    SELECT player_id,\n           SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs_scored,\n           MAX(runs_scored) AS highest_score,\n           SUM(runs_scored >= 30) AS matches_with_30_plus,\n           SUM(runs_scored >= 50) AS matches_with_50_plus,\n           SUM(runs_scored >= 100) AS matches_with_100_plus,\n           SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls_faced\n    FROM batting_by_match\n    GROUP BY player_id\n),\ndismissals AS (\n    SELECT player_out AS player_id,\n           COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals\n    FROM main.wicket_taken\n    WHERE kind_out <> 'retired hurt'\n    GROUP BY player_out\n),\nbowling_by_match AS (\n    SELECT b.bowler AS player_id,\n           b.match_id,\n           SUM(COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0)) AS runs_given,\n           -- Count recorded deliveries for economy while ignoring the extra-runs data.\n           COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled,\n           COUNT(CASE WHEN w.kind_out IN (\n               'bowled', 'caught', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket', 'lbw', 'stumped'\n           ) THEN 1 END) AS wickets_taken\n    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b\n    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)\n    LEFT JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)\n    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id\n),\nbowling_career AS (\n    SELECT player_id,\n           wickets_taken || '-' || runs_given AS best_bowling_performance,\n           SUM(wickets_taken) OVER player_matches AS total_wickets_taken,\n           SUM(runs_given) OVER player_matches AS total_runs_given,\n           SUM(balls_bowled) OVER player_matches AS total_balls_bowled,\n           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (\n               PARTITION BY player_id\n               ORDER BY wickets_taken DESC, runs_given, match_id\n           ) AS performance_rank\n    FROM bowling_by_match\n    WINDOW player_matches AS (PARTITION BY player_id)\n)\nSELECT p.player_id,\n       p.player_name,\n       a.most_frequent_role,\n       p.batting_hand,\n       p.bowling_skill,\n       COALESCE(bt.total_runs_scored, 0) AS total_runs_scored,\n       COALESCE(a.total_matches_played, 0) AS total_matches_played,\n       COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS total_dismissals,\n       1.0 * COALESCE(bt.total_runs_scored, 0) / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS batting_average,\n       bt.highest_score,\n       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_30_plus, 0) AS matches_with_30_plus,\n       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_50_plus, 0) AS matches_with_50_plus,\n       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_100_plus, 0) AS matches_with_100_plus,\n       COALESCE(bt.total_balls_faced, 0) AS total_balls_faced,\n       100.0 * bt.total_runs_scored / NULLIF(bt.total_balls_faced, 0) AS strike_rate,\n       COALESCE(bw.total_wickets_taken, 0) AS total_wickets_taken,\n       6.0 * bw.total_runs_given / NULLIF(bw.total_balls_bowled, 0) AS economy_rate,\n       bw.best_bowling_performance\nFROM main.player AS p\nLEFT JOIN appearances AS a ON a.player_id = p.player_id\nLEFT JOIN batting_career AS bt ON bt.player_id = p.player_id\nLEFT JOIN dismissals AS d ON d.player_id = p.player_id\nLEFT JOIN bowling_career AS bw ON bw.player_id = p.player_id AND bw.performance_rank = 1\nORDER BY p.player_id",

extra-runs data.\n           COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled,\n           COUNT(CASE WHEN w.kind_out IN (\n               'bowled', 'caught', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket', 'lbw', 'stumped'\n           ) THEN 1 END) AS wickets_taken\n    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b\n    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)\n    LEFT JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)\n    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id\n),\nbowling_career AS (\n    SELECT player_id,\n           wickets_taken || '-' || runs_given AS best_bowling_performance,\n           SUM(wickets_taken) OVER player_matches AS total_wickets_taken,\n           SUM(runs_given) OVER player_matches AS total_runs_given,\n           SUM(balls_bowled) OVER player_matches AS total_balls_bowled,\n           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (\n               PARTITION BY player_id\n               ORDER BY wickets_taken DESC, runs_given, match_id\n           ) AS performance_rank\n    FROM bowling_by_match\n    WINDOW player_matches AS (PARTITION BY player_id)\n)\nSELECT p.player_id,\n       p.player_name,\n       a.most_frequent_role,\n       p.batting_hand,\n       p.bowling_skill,\n       COALESCE(bt.total_runs_scored, 0) AS total_runs_scored,\n       COALESCE(a.total_matches_played, 0) AS total_matches_played,\n       COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS total_dismissals,\n       1.0 * COALESCE(bt.total_runs_scored, 0) / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS batting_average,\n       bt.highest_score,\n       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_30_plus, 0) AS matches_with_30_plus,\n       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_50_plus, 0) AS matches_with_50_plus,\n       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_100_plus, 0) AS matches_with_100_plus,\n       COALESCE(bt.total_balls_faced, 0) AS total_balls_faced,\n       100.0 * bt.total_runs_scored / NULLIF(bt.total_balls_faced, 0) AS strike_rate,\n       COALESCE(bw.total_wickets_taken, 0) AS total_wickets_taken,\n       6.0 * bw.total_runs_given / NULLIF(bw.total_balls_bowled, 0) AS economy_rate,\n       bw.best_bowling_performance\nFROM main.player AS p\nLEFT JOIN appearances AS a ON a.player_id = p.player_id\nLEFT JOIN batting_career AS bt ON bt.player_id = p.player_id\nLEFT JOIN dismissals AS d ON d.player_id = p.player_id\nLEFT JOIN Final SQL / answer

WITH role_counts AS (
    SELECT player_id, role, COUNT(*) AS matches_in_role
    FROM main.player_match
    GROUP BY player_id, role
),
ranked_roles AS (
    SELECT player_id, role,
           SUM(matches_in_role) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS matches_played,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY matches_in_role DESC, role
           ) AS role_rank
    FROM role_counts
),
deliveries AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.striker, b.bowler,
           COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0) AS runs,
           CASE WHEN w.kind_out IN (
               'bowled', 'caught', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket', 'lbw', 'stumped'
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bowler_wicket
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    LEFT JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
),
batting_by_match AS (
    SELECT striker AS player_id, match_id, SUM(runs) AS match_runs,
           COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
    FROM deliveries
    GROUP BY striker, match_id
),
batting AS (
    SELECT player_id, SUM(match_runs) AS total_runs,
           MAX(match_runs) AS highest_score,
           SUM(match_runs >= 30) AS matches_30_plus,
           SUM(match_runs >= 50) AS matches_50_plus,
           SUM(match_runs >= 100) AS matches_100_plus,
           SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls_faced
    FROM batting_by_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals
    FROM main.wicket_taken
    WHERE kind_out <> 'retired hurt'
    GROUP BY player_out
),
bowling_by_match AS (
    SELECT bowler AS player_id, match_id, SUM(bowler_wicket) AS wickets,
           SUM(runs) AS runs_given, COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled
    FROM deliveries
    GROUP BY bowler, match_id
),
bowling AS (
    SELECT player_id, wickets, runs_given,
           SUM(wickets) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS total_wickets,
           6.0 * SUM(runs_given) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id)
               / SUM(balls_bowled) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS economy_rate,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY wickets DESC, runs_given, match_id
           ) AS performance_rank
    FROM bowling_by_match
)
SELECT p.player_id, p.player_name, r.role AS most_frequent_role,
       p.batting_hand, p.bowling_skill,
       COALESCE(b.total_runs, 0) AS total_runs,
       COALESCE(r.matches_played, 0) AS total_matches_played,
       COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS total_dismissals,
       1.0 * COALESCE(b.total_runs, 0) / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS batting_average,
       COALESCE(b.highest_score, 0) AS highest_score,
       COALESCE(b.matches_30_plus, 0) AS matches_30_plus,
       COALESCE(b.matches_50_plus, 0) AS matches_50_plus,
       COALESCE(b.matches_100_plus, 0) AS matches_100_plus,
       COALESCE(b.total_balls_faced, 0) AS total_balls_faced,
       100.0 * b.total_runs / NULLIF(b.total_balls_faced, 0) AS strike_rate,
       COALESCE(w.total_wickets, 0) AS total_wickets,
       w.economy_rate,
       w.wickets || '-' || w.runs_given AS best_bowling_performance
FROM main.player AS p
LEFT JOIN ranked_roles AS r ON r.player_id = p.player_id AND r.role_rank = 1
LEFT JOIN batting AS b ON b.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals AS d ON d.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowling AS w ON w.player_id = p.player_id AND w.performance_rank = 1
ORDER BY p.player_id
LIMIT 1000

role,\n           SUM(matches_in_role) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS matches_played,\n           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (\n               PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY matches_in_role DESC, role\n           ) AS role_rank\n    FROM role_counts\n),\ndeliveries AS (\n    SELECT b.match_id, b.striker, b.bowler,\n           COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0) AS runs,\n           CASE WHEN w.kind_out IN (\n               'bowled', 'caught', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket', 'lbw', 'stumped'\n           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bowler_wicket\n    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b\n    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)\n    LEFT JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)\n),\nbatting_by_match AS (\n    SELECT striker AS player_id, match_id, SUM(runs) AS match_runs,\n           COUNT(*) AS balls_faced\n    FROM deliveries\n    GROUP BY striker, match_id\n),\nbatting AS (\n    SELECT player_id, SUM(match_runs) AS total_runs,\n           MAX(match_runs) AS highest_score,\n           SUM(match_runs >= 30) AS matches_30_plus,\n           SUM(match_runs >= 50) AS matches_50_plus,\n           SUM(match_runs >= 100) AS matches_100_plus,\n           SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls_faced\n    FROM batting_by_match\n    GROUP BY player_id\n),\ndismissals AS (\n    SELECT player_out AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals\n    FROM main.wicket_taken\n    WHERE kind_out <> 'retired hurt'\n    GROUP BY player_out\n),\nbowling_by_match AS (\n    SELECT bowler AS player_id, match_id, SUM(bowler_wicket) AS wickets,\n           SUM(runs) AS runs_given, COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled\n    FROM deliveries\n    GROUP BY bowler, match_id\n),\nbowling AS (\n    SELECT player_id, wickets, runs_given,\n           SUM(wickets) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS total_wickets,\n           6.0 * SUM(runs_given) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id)\n               / SUM(balls_bowled) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS economy_rate,\n           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (\n               PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY wickets DESC, runs_given, match_id\n           ) AS performance_rank\n    FROM bowling_by_match\n)\nSELECT p.player_id, p.player_name, r.role AS most_frequent_role,\n       p.batting_hand, p.bowling_skill,\n       COALESCE(b.total_runs, 0) AS total_runs,\n       COALESCE(r.matches_played, 0) AS total_matches_played,\n       COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS total_dismissals,\n       1.0 * COALESCE(b.total_runs, 0) / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS batting_average,\n       COALESCE(b.highest_score, 0) AS highest_score,\n       COALESCE(b.matches_30_plus, 0) AS matches_30_plus,\n       COALESCE(b.matches_50_plus, 0) AS matches_50_plus,\n       COALESCE(b.matches_100_plus, 0) AS matches_100_plus,\n       COALESCE(b.total_balls_faced, 0) AS total_balls_faced,\n       100.0 * b.total_runs / NULLIF(b.total_balls_faced, 0) AS strike_rate,\n       COALESCE(w.total_wickets, 0) AS total_wickets,\n       w.economy_rate,\n       w.wickets || '-' || w.runs_given AS best_bowling_performance\nFROM main.player AS p\nLEFT JOIN ranked_roles AS r ON r.player_id = p.player_id AND r.role_rank = 1\nLEFT JOIN batting AS b ON b.player_id = p.player_id\nLEFT JOIN dismissals AS d ON d.player_id = p.player_id\nLEFT JOIN bowling AS w ON w.player_id = p.player_id AND w.performance_rank = 1\nORDER BY p.player_id",

Final SQL / answer

WITH team_lineups AS (
    SELECT id AS match_id,
           CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 'Win' ELSE 'Loss' END AS outcome,
           json_array(
               home_player_1, home_player_2, home_player_3, home_player_4,
               home_player_5, home_player_6, home_player_7, home_player_8,
               home_player_9, home_player_10, home_player_11
           ) AS lineup
    FROM main."Match"
    WHERE home_team_goal <> away_team_goal

    UNION ALL

    SELECT id AS match_id,
           CASE WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 'Win' ELSE 'Loss' END AS outcome,
           json_array(
               away_player_1, away_player_2, away_player_3, away_player_4,
               away_player_5, away_player_6, away_player_7, away_player_8,
               away_player_9, away_player_10, away_player_11
           ) AS lineup
    FROM main."Match"
    WHERE home_team_goal <> away_team_goal
),
player_totals AS (
    SELECT t.outcome,
           slot.value AS player_api_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT t.match_id) AS match_count
    FROM team_lineups AS t
    CROSS JOIN json_each(t.lineup) AS slot
    WHERE slot.value IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY t.outcome, slot.value
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT outcome, player_api_id, match_count,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY outcome ORDER BY match_count DESC) AS outcome_rank
    FROM player_totals
)
SELECT r.outcome, p.player_name, r.match_count
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN main.Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = r.player_api_id
WHERE r.outcome_rank = 1
ORDER BY CASE r.outcome WHEN 'Win' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, p.player_name
LIMIT 1000

Final SQL / answer

WITH appearances AS (
    SELECT m.match_api_id, p.player_api_id,
           CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 'Win' ELSE 'Loss' END AS outcome
    FROM main."Match" AS m
    JOIN main.Player AS p ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4,
        m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8,
        m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11
    )
    WHERE m.home_team_goal <> m.away_team_goal

    UNION ALL

    SELECT m.match_api_id, p.player_api_id,
           CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 'Win' ELSE 'Loss' END AS outcome
    FROM main."Match" AS m
    JOIN main.Player AS p ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
        m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8,
        m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
    WHERE m.home_team_goal <> m.away_team_goal
),
counts AS (
    SELECT outcome, player_api_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_api_id) AS match_count
    FROM appearances
    GROUP BY outcome, player_api_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT counts.*,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY outcome ORDER BY match_count DESC) AS outcome_rank
    FROM counts
)
SELECT r.outcome, p.player_name, r.match_count
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN main.Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = r.player_api_id
WHERE r.outcome_rank = 1
ORDER BY r.outcome DESC, p.player_name
LIMIT 1000

Final SQL / answer

WITH monthly_interest AS (
    SELECT
        DATE(PRINTF('%04d-%02d-01', m._year, m._month)) AS month_start,
        m.interest_id,
        AVG(1.0 * m.composition / NULLIF(m.index_value, 0)) AS average_composition
    FROM main.interest_metrics AS m
    WHERE m._year * 100 + m._month BETWEEN 201807 AND 201908
    GROUP BY m._year, m._month, m.interest_id
),
ranked_interest AS (
    SELECT
        month_start,
        interest_id,
        average_composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY month_start
            ORDER BY average_composition DESC, interest_id
        ) AS month_rank
    FROM monthly_interest
    WHERE average_composition IS NOT NULL
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT
        r.month_start,
        i.interest_name,
        r.average_composition AS max_index_composition
    FROM ranked_interest AS r
    JOIN main.interest_map AS i ON i.id = r.interest_id
    WHERE r.month_rank = 1
),
rolling_composition AS (
    SELECT
        month_start,
        interest_name,
        max_index_composition,
        AVG(max_index_composition) OVER (
            ORDER BY month_start ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS three_month_rolling_average,
        LAG(interest_name, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS one_month_ago_interest_name,
        LAG(max_index_composition, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS one_month_ago_max_index_composition,
        LAG(interest_name, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS two_months_ago_interest_name,
        LAG(max_index_composition, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS two_months_ago_max_index_composition
    FROM monthly_max
)
SELECT
    month_start,
    interest_name,
    max_index_composition,
    three_month_rolling_average,
    one_month_ago_interest_name,
    one_month_ago_max_index_composition,
    two_months_ago_interest_name,
    two_months_ago_max_index_composition
FROM rolling_composition
WHERE month_start >= '2018-09-01' AND month_start < '2019-09-01'
ORDER BY month_start
LIMIT 12

Final SQL / answer

WITH monthly_interest AS (
    SELECT
        printf('%04d-%02d-01', m._year, m._month) AS month_start,
        m.interest_id,
        AVG(1.0 * m.composition / NULLIF(m.index_value, 0)) AS avg_composition
    FROM main.interest_metrics AS m
    WHERE (m._year, m._month) BETWEEN (2018, 7) AND (2019, 8)
    GROUP BY m._year, m._month, m.interest_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        month_start,
        interest_id,
        avg_composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY month_start
            ORDER BY avg_composition DESC, interest_id
        ) AS position
    FROM monthly_interest
),
monthly_winners AS (
    SELECT
        r.month_start,
        i.interest_name,
        r.avg_composition AS max_index_composition
    FROM ranked AS r
    JOIN main.interest_map AS i ON i.id = r.interest_id
    WHERE r.position = 1
),
history AS (
    SELECT
        month_start AS date,
        interest_name,
        max_index_composition,
        AVG(max_index_composition) OVER (
            monthly_order ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS three_month_rolling_average,
        LAG(interest_name, 1) OVER monthly_order AS interest_one_month_ago,
        LAG(max_index_composition, 1) OVER monthly_order AS max_index_composition_one_month_ago,
        LAG(interest_name, 2) OVER monthly_order AS interest_two_months_ago,
        LAG(max_index_composition, 2) OVER monthly_order AS max_index_composition_two_months_ago
    FROM monthly_winners
    WINDOW monthly_order AS (ORDER BY month_start)
)
SELECT *
FROM history
WHERE date BETWEEN '2018-09-01' AND '2019-08-01'
ORDER BY date
LIMIT 12

Final SQL / answer

WITH visits AS (
    SELECT path,
           LEAD(path, 1) OVER visit_order AS second_page,
           LEAD(path, 2) OVER visit_order AS third_page
    FROM main.activity_log
    WHERE action = 'view'
    WINDOW visit_order AS (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, rowid)
)
SELECT third_page, COUNT(*) AS visit_count
FROM visits
WHERE path = '/detail'
  AND second_page = '/detail'
  AND third_page IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY third_page
ORDER BY visit_count DESC, third_page DESC
LIMIT 3

      "sql": "WITH ordered AS (\n    SELECT path,\n           LAG(path, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, rowid) AS previous_path,\n           LAG(path, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, rowid) AS second_previous_path,\n           stamp,\n           LAG(stamp, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, rowid) AS previous_stamp,\n           LAG(stamp, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, rowid) AS second_previous_stamp\n    FROM main.activity_log\n    WHERE action = 'view'\n)\nSELECT path, COUNT(*) AS visit_count,\n       SUM(stamp = previous_stamp) AS same_as_previous_stamp,\n       SUM(previous_stamp = second_previous_stamp) AS same_stamp_for_pair\nFROM ordered\nWHERE previous_path = '/detail' AND second_previous_path = '/detail'\nGROUP BY path\nORDER BY visit_count DESC, path\nLIMIT 20"

Final SQL / answer

WITH visits AS (
    SELECT
        path AS third_page,
        LAG(path, 1) OVER visit_order AS previous_page,
        LAG(path, 2) OVER visit_order AS two_pages_back
    FROM main.activity_log
    WHERE action = 'view'
    WINDOW visit_order AS (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, rowid)
)
SELECT third_page, COUNT(*) AS occurrences
FROM visits
WHERE previous_page = '/detail'
  AND two_pages_back = '/detail'
  AND third_page <> ''
GROUP BY third_page
ORDER BY occurrences DESC, third_page
LIMIT 3;

Final SQL / answer

WITH ranked_grades AS (
    SELECT
        st.StudLastName,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY ss.Grade DESC) AS grade_share
    FROM Student_Schedules AS ss
    JOIN Students AS st ON st.StudentID = ss.StudentID
    JOIN Classes AS c ON c.ClassID = ss.ClassID
    JOIN Subjects AS sub ON sub.SubjectID = c.SubjectID
    WHERE ss.ClassStatus = 2
      AND sub.CategoryID = 'ENG'
)
SELECT
    StudLastName,
    CASE
        WHEN grade_share <= 0.20 THEN 'First'
        WHEN grade_share <= 0.40 THEN 'Second'
        WHEN grade_share <= 0.60 THEN 'Third'
        WHEN grade_share <= 0.80 THEN 'Fourth'
        ELSE 'Fifth'
    END AS Quintile
FROM ranked_grades
ORDER BY grade_share, StudLastName
LIMIT 1000

Final SQL / answer

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT s.StudLastName,
           CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY ss.Grade DESC) AS rank_share
    FROM main.Student_Schedules AS ss
    JOIN main.Students AS s ON s.StudentID = ss.StudentID
    JOIN main.Classes AS c ON c.ClassID = ss.ClassID
    JOIN main.Subjects AS sub ON sub.SubjectID = c.SubjectID
    JOIN main.Categories AS cat ON cat.CategoryID = sub.CategoryID
    WHERE ss.ClassStatus = 2
      AND cat.CategoryDescription = 'English'
)
SELECT StudLastName,
       CASE
           WHEN rank_share <= 0.20 THEN 'First'
           WHEN rank_share <= 0.40 THEN 'Second'
           WHEN rank_share <= 0.60 THEN 'Third'
           WHEN rank_share <= 0.80 THEN 'Fourth'
           ELSE 'Fifth'
       END AS Quintile
FROM ranked
ORDER BY rank_share, StudLastName
LIMIT -1

Final SQL / answer

WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.delivery_order_id
    FROM deliveries AS d
    WHERE d.delivery_status = 'DELIVERED'
),
store_totals AS (
    SELECT
        s.store_id,
        s.store_name,
        COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
        COUNT(d.delivery_order_id) AS delivered_orders
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
    LEFT JOIN delivered_orders AS d ON d.delivery_order_id = o.delivery_order_id
    GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
)
SELECT
    store_name,
    total_orders,
    1.0 * delivered_orders / total_orders AS delivered_order_ratio
FROM store_totals
WHERE total_orders = (SELECT MAX(total_orders) FROM store_totals)
ORDER BY store_id
LIMIT 1000

WITH delivered_keys AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.delivery_order_id
    FROM main.deliveries AS d
    WHERE d.delivery_status = 'DELIVERED'
),
store_counts AS (
    SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name,
           COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
           COUNT(dk.delivery_order_id) AS delivered_orders
    FROM main.orders AS o
    JOIN main.stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
    LEFT JOIN delivered_keys AS dk ON dk.delivery_order_id = o.delivery_order_id
    GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
)
SELECT store_id, store_name, total_orders,
       1.0 * delivered_orders / total_orders AS delivered_ratio
FROM store_counts
WHERE total_orders = (SELECT MAX(total_orders) FROM store_counts)
ORDER BY store_id
LIMIT 1000

Final SQL / answer

WITH product_month_sales AS (
    SELECT s.prod_id,
           t.calendar_year AS sales_year,
           t.calendar_month_number AS month,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) AS amount
    FROM main.sales AS s
    JOIN main.customers AS cu ON cu.cust_id = s.cust_id
    JOIN main.countries AS co ON co.country_id = cu.country_id
    JOIN main.times AS t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
    JOIN main.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = s.promo_id
    JOIN main.channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
      AND p.promo_total_id = 1
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020, 2021)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number
),
monthly_averages AS (
    SELECT target.month,
           ROUND(AVG(
               (
                   (recent.amount - prior.amount) / NULLIF(prior.amount, 0)
                   * recent.amount + recent.amount
               ) * COALESCE(fx.to_us, 1.0)
           ), 2) AS average_projected_sales_usd
    FROM product_month_sales AS target
    LEFT JOIN product_month_sales AS prior
      ON prior.prod_id = target.prod_id
     AND prior.month = target.month
     AND prior.sales_year = 2019
    LEFT JOIN product_month_sales AS recent
      ON recent.prod_id = target.prod_id
     AND recent.month = target.month
     AND recent.sales_year = 2020
    LEFT JOIN main.currency AS fx
      ON fx.country = 'France'
     AND fx.year = target.sales_year
     AND fx.month = target.month
    WHERE target.sales_year = 2021
    GROUP BY target.month
),
ranked_months AS (
    SELECT average_projected_sales_usd,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_projected_sales_usd) AS month_rank,
           COUNT(*) OVER () AS month_count
    FROM monthly_averages
    WHERE average_projected_sales_usd IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(average_projected_sales_usd) AS median_average_monthly_projected_sales_usd
FROM ranked_months
WHERE month_rank IN ((month_count + 1) / 2, (month_count + 2) / 2)
LIMIT 1

Final SQL / answer

WITH product_month_sales AS (
    SELECT
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_month_number AS month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2019 THEN s.amount_sold END) AS sales_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2020 THEN s.amount_sold END) AS sales_2020
    FROM main.sales AS s
    JOIN main.times AS t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
    JOIN main.customers AS c ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id
    JOIN main.countries AS co ON co.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN main.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = s.promo_id
    JOIN main.channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
      AND p.promo_total_id = 1
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_month_number
),
projections AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        sales_2020 + sales_2020 * (
            1.0 * (sales_2020 - sales_2019) / NULLIF(sales_2019, 0)
        ) AS projected_sales
    FROM product_month_sales
),
monthly_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.month,
        ROUND(AVG(p.projected_sales * COALESCE(fx.to_us, 1.0)), 2) AS avg_usd
    FROM projections AS p
    LEFT JOIN main.currency AS fx
        ON fx.country = 'France' AND fx.year = 2021 AND fx.month = p.month
    GROUP BY p.month
),
ranked_months AS (
    SELECT
        avg_usd,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_usd, month) AS position,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS month_count
    FROM monthly_averages
    WHERE avg_usd IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(avg_usd) AS median_monthly_average_usd
FROM ranked_months
WHERE position BETWEEN (month_count + 1) / 2 AND (month_count + 2) / 2
LIMIT 1

{
  "instance_id": "local152",
  "db": "imdb_movies",
  "question": "Can you provide the top 9 directors by movie count, including their ID, name, number of movies, average inter-movie duration (rounded to the nearest integer), average rating (rounded to 2 decimals), total votes, minimum and maximum ratings, and total movie duration? Sort the output first by movie count in descending order and then by total movie duration in descending order.",
  "external_knowledge": null,
  "document_sha256": null
}

SQL diff

--- before.sql
+++ after.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+WITH director_movies AS (
+    SELECT
+        d.name_id AS director_id,
+        m.id AS movie_id,
+        m.duration,
+        julianday(m.date_published) - LAG(julianday(m.date_published)) OVER (
+            PARTITION BY d.name_id
+            ORDER BY m.date_published, m.id
+        ) AS gap_days
+    FROM director_mapping AS d
+    JOIN movies AS m ON m.id = d.movie_id
+)
+SELECT
+    dm.director_id,
+    n.name AS director_name,
+    COUNT(*) AS movie_count,
+    CAST(ROUND(AVG(dm.gap_days)) AS INTEGER) AS avg_inter_movie_days,
+    ROUND(AVG(r.avg_rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
+    SUM(r.total_votes) AS total_votes,
+    MIN(r.avg_rating) AS min_rating,
+    MAX(r.avg_rating) AS max_rating,
+    SUM(dm.duration) AS total_movie_duration
+FROM director_movies AS dm
+JOIN names AS n ON n.id = dm.director_id
+LEFT JOIN ratings AS r ON r.movie_id = dm.movie_id
+GROUP BY dm.director_id, n.name
+ORDER BY movie_count DESC, total_movie_duration DESC
+LIMIT 9

Final SQL / answer

WITH director_movies AS (
    SELECT
        d.name_id AS director_id,
        m.id AS movie_id,
        m.duration,
        julianday(m.date_published) - LAG(julianday(m.date_published)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.name_id
            ORDER BY m.date_published, m.id
        ) AS gap_days
    FROM director_mapping AS d
    JOIN movies AS m ON m.id = d.movie_id
)
SELECT
    dm.director_id,
    n.name AS director_name,
    COUNT(*) AS movie_count,
    CAST(ROUND(AVG(dm.gap_days)) AS INTEGER) AS avg_inter_movie_days,
    ROUND(AVG(r.avg_rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
    SUM(r.total_votes) AS total_votes,
    MIN(r.avg_rating) AS min_rating,
    MAX(r.avg_rating) AS max_rating,
    SUM(dm.duration) AS total_movie_duration
FROM director_movies AS dm
JOIN names AS n ON n.id = dm.director_id
LEFT JOIN ratings AS r ON r.movie_id = dm.movie_id
GROUP BY dm.director_id, n.name
ORDER BY movie_count DESC, total_movie_duration DESC
LIMIT 9

Final SQL / answer

WITH RECURSIVE salary_digits(Location, CompanyName, remaining_text, digits) AS (
    SELECT Location, CompanyName, Salary, ''
    FROM main.SalaryDataset
    WHERE Salary IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        Location,
        CompanyName,
        substr(remaining_text, 2),
        digits || CASE
            WHEN substr(remaining_text, 1, 1) GLOB '[0-9]'
                THEN substr(remaining_text, 1, 1)
            ELSE ''
        END
    FROM salary_digits
    WHERE remaining_text <> ''
),
cleaned_salaries AS (
    -- Average the stored amounts after stripping currency and pay-period text.
    SELECT Location, CompanyName, CAST(digits AS REAL) AS salary_amount
    FROM salary_digits
    WHERE remaining_text = '' AND digits <> ''
),
city_company_averages AS (
    SELECT Location, CompanyName, AVG(salary_amount) AS city_average
    FROM cleaned_salaries
    WHERE Location IN ('Mumbai', 'Pune', 'New Delhi', 'Hyderabad')
    GROUP BY Location, CompanyName
),
ranked_companies AS (
    SELECT
        Location,
        CompanyName,
        city_average,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Location
            ORDER BY city_average DESC, CompanyName
        ) AS city_rank
    FROM city_company_averages
),
national_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(salary_amount) AS country_average
    FROM cleaned_salaries
)
SELECT
    ranked_companies.Location AS "Location",
    ranked_companies.CompanyName AS "Company Name",
    ranked_companies.city_average AS "Average Salary in State",
    national_average.country_average AS "Average Salary in Country"
FROM ranked_companies
CROSS JOIN national_average
WHERE ranked_companies.city_rank <= 5
ORDER BY ranked_companies.Location, ranked_companies.city_rank
LIMIT 20

      "sql": "WITH salary_formats AS (\n    SELECT\n        Location,\n        Salary,\n        CASE WHEN instr(Salary, '/') > 0\n             THEN substr(Salary, instr(Salary, '/'))\n             ELSE '(no suffix)'\n        END AS suffix,\n        CASE WHEN instr(Salary, '/') > 0\n             THEN substr(Salary, 1, instr(Salary, '/') - 1)\n             ELSE Salary\n        END AS amount_text\n    FROM main.SalaryDataset\n),\nprofile AS (\n    SELECT\n        Location,\n        Salary,\n        suffix,\n        REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(amount_text), '₹', ''), ',', '') AS amount\n    FROM salary_formats\n)\nSELECT\n    suffix,\n    COUNT(*) AS records,\n    COUNT(DISTINCT Location) AS locations,\n    MIN(Salary) AS example_salary,\n    SUM(CASE WHEN amount IS NULL OR amount = '' OR amount GLOB '*[^0-9]*'\n             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unusual_amounts,\n    MIN(CASE WHEN amount IS NULL OR amount = '' OR amount GLOB '*[^0-9]*'\n             THEN Salary END) AS unusual_example\nFROM profile\nGROUP BY suffix\nORDER BY records DESC"
    },

Final SQL / answer

WITH cleaned_salaries AS (
    -- Average the recorded amounts as requested. Currency and pay-period labels are stripped.
    SELECT
        Location,
        CompanyName,
        CAST(
            NULLIF(
                REPLACE(
                    LTRIM(SUBSTR(Salary, 1, INSTR(Salary, '/') - 1), '₹$£AFN '),
                    ',', ''
                ),
                ''
            ) AS REAL
        ) AS salary_amount
    FROM main.SalaryDataset
),
national_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(salary_amount) AS country_average
    FROM cleaned_salaries
),
company_averages AS (
    SELECT Location, CompanyName, AVG(salary_amount) AS city_company_average
    FROM cleaned_salaries
    WHERE Location IN ('Mumbai', 'Pune', 'New Delhi', 'Hyderabad')
      AND CompanyName IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(CompanyName) <> ''
    GROUP BY Location, CompanyName
),
ranked_companies AS (
    SELECT
        Location,
        CompanyName,
        city_company_average,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Location
            ORDER BY city_company_average DESC, CompanyName ASC
        ) AS city_rank
    FROM company_averages
)
SELECT
    r.Location AS "Location",
    r.CompanyName AS "Company Name",
    r.city_company_average AS "Average Salary in State",
    n.country_average AS "Average Salary in Country"
FROM ranked_companies AS r
CROSS JOIN national_average AS n
WHERE r.city_rank <= 5
ORDER BY r.Location, r.city_rank
LIMIT 1000

  "question": "Identify the L1_model associated with each model (specified by name and version) that occurs most frequently for each status ('strong' or 'soft'), along with the number of times it occurs. A model has a 'strong' status if, for any of its steps, the maximum test score among non-'Stack' models is less than the 'Stack' model's test score. It has a 'soft' status if the maximum test score among non-'Stack' models equals the 'Stack' model's test score. Count how many times each L1_model is associated with a 'strong' or 'soft' status across all models, and determine which L1_model has the highest occurrence for each status.",

Final SQL / answer

WITH model_statuses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT name, version, L1_model, status
    FROM main.stack_ok
    WHERE status IN ('strong', 'soft')
),
status_counts AS (
    SELECT status, L1_model, COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count
    FROM model_statuses
    GROUP BY status, L1_model
),
ranked_counts AS (
    SELECT status, L1_model, occurrence_count,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY occurrence_count DESC) AS status_rank
    FROM status_counts
)
SELECT status, L1_model, occurrence_count
FROM ranked_counts
WHERE status_rank = 1
ORDER BY status, L1_model
LIMIT -1

WITH model_statuses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT name, version, L1_model, status
    FROM main.stack_ok
    WHERE status IN ('strong', 'soft')
),
ranked_counts AS (
    SELECT status, L1_model, COUNT(*) AS occurrences,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS frequency_rank
    FROM model_statuses
    GROUP BY status, L1_model
)
SELECT status, L1_model, occurrences
FROM ranked_counts
WHERE frequency_rank = 1
ORDER BY status, L1_model
LIMIT 1000

Final SQL / answer

WITH collision_helmet_use AS (
    SELECT
        c.case_id,
        c.motorcyclist_killed_count,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet used')
              OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet used')
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS helmet_used,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet not used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used')
              OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet not used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used')
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS helmet_not_used
    FROM main.collisions AS c
    JOIN main.parties AS p ON p.case_id = c.case_id
    WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
      AND p.party_type IN ('driver', 'passenger')
    GROUP BY c.case_id, c.motorcyclist_killed_count
)
SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(motorcyclist_killed_count) FILTER (WHERE helmet_used = 1)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE helmet_used = 1), 0) AS helmet_used_fatality_pct,
    100.0 * SUM(motorcyclist_killed_count) FILTER (WHERE helmet_not_used = 1)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE helmet_not_used = 1), 0) AS helmet_not_used_fatality_pct
FROM collision_helmet_use
LIMIT 1

Final SQL / answer

WITH helmet_codes(equipment, helmet_used) AS (
    VALUES
        ('driver, motorcycle helmet used', 1),
        ('passenger, motorcycle helmet used', 1),
        ('driver, motorcycle helmet not used', 0),
        ('passenger, motorcycle helmet not used', 0)
),
collision_groups AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.case_id, h.helmet_used
    FROM main.parties AS p
    JOIN helmet_codes AS h
      ON h.equipment IN (p.party_safety_equipment_1, p.party_safety_equipment_2)
)
SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(c.motorcyclist_killed_count) FILTER (WHERE g.helmet_used = 1)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE g.helmet_used = 1), 0) AS helmet_used_fatality_pct,
    100.0 * SUM(c.motorcyclist_killed_count) FILTER (WHERE g.helmet_used = 0)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE g.helmet_used = 0), 0) AS helmet_not_used_fatality_pct
FROM main.collisions AS c
JOIN collision_groups AS g ON g.case_id = c.case_id
WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
LIMIT 1

Final SQL / answer

WITH product_totals AS (
    SELECT p.division, p.product, SUM(s.sold_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold
    FROM main.hardware_fact_sales_monthly AS s
    JOIN main.hardware_dim_product AS p ON p.product_code = s.product_code
    WHERE s.date >= '2021-01-01' AND s.date < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY p.division, p.product
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT total_quantity_sold,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY division
               ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC, product
           ) AS division_rank
    FROM product_totals
)
SELECT AVG(total_quantity_sold) AS overall_avg_quantity_sold
FROM ranked_products
WHERE division_rank <= 3
LIMIT 1

Final SQL / answer

WITH product_totals AS (
    SELECT p.division, p.product_code, SUM(s.sold_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly AS s
    JOIN hardware_dim_product AS p ON p.product_code = s.product_code
    WHERE s.date >= '2021-01-01' AND s.date < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY p.division, p.product_code
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT total_quantity,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY division
               ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, product_code
           ) AS division_rank
    FROM product_totals
)
SELECT AVG(total_quantity) AS overall_average_quantity_sold
FROM ranked_products
WHERE division_rank <= 3
LIMIT 1

Final SQL / answer

WITH RECURSIVE
daily_changes AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        txn_date AS balance_date,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS net_change
    FROM main.customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
reporting_end AS (
    SELECT MAX(balance_date) AS last_day
    FROM daily_changes
),
customer_days(customer_id, balance_date, baseline_month, last_day) AS (
    SELECT
        d.customer_id,
        MIN(d.balance_date),
        strftime('%Y-%m', MIN(d.balance_date)),
        r.last_day
    FROM daily_changes AS d
    CROSS JOIN reporting_end AS r
    GROUP BY d.customer_id, r.last_day

    UNION ALL

    SELECT customer_id, date(balance_date, '+1 day'), baseline_month, last_day
    FROM customer_days
    WHERE balance_date < last_day
),
daily_balances AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.balance_date,
        c.baseline_month,
        SUM(COALESCE(d.net_change, 0)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.customer_id
            ORDER BY c.balance_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS running_balance
    FROM customer_days AS c
    LEFT JOIN daily_changes AS d
        ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id
       AND d.balance_date = c.balance_date
),
rolling_balances AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', balance_date) AS month,
        baseline_month,
        COUNT(*) OVER trailing_days AS days_in_window,
        AVG(running_balance) OVER trailing_days AS average_balance
    FROM daily_balances
    WINDOW trailing_days AS (
        PARTITION BY customer_id
        ORDER BY balance_date
        ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    )
),
customer_monthly_maxima AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        month,
        MAX(MAX(average_balance, 0.0)) AS max_30_day_average_balance
    FROM rolling_balances
    WHERE days_in_window = 30
      AND month > baseline_month
    GROUP BY customer_id, month
)
SELECT
    month,
    SUM(max_30_day_average_balance) AS total_max_30_day_average_balance
FROM customer_monthly_maxima
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 1000

Final SQL / answer

WITH RECURSIVE
daily_changes AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date AS day,
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS net_change
    FROM main.customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
customer_days(customer_id, day, baseline_month) AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(day), strftime('%Y-%m', MIN(day))
    FROM daily_changes
    GROUP BY customer_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT customer_id, date(day, '+1 day'), baseline_month
    FROM customer_days
    WHERE day < (SELECT MAX(day) FROM daily_changes)
),
daily_balances AS (
    SELECT d.customer_id, d.day, d.baseline_month,
           SUM(COALESCE(c.net_change, 0)) OVER (
               PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.day
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS balance
    FROM customer_days AS d
    LEFT JOIN daily_changes AS c
      ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id AND c.day = d.day
),
rolling_balances AS (
    SELECT customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', day) AS month, baseline_month,
           COUNT(*) OVER trailing_month AS days_in_window,
           AVG(balance) OVER trailing_month AS average_balance
    FROM daily_balances
    WINDOW trailing_month AS (
        PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY day
        ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    )
),
monthly_maxima AS (
    SELECT customer_id, month,
           MAX(CASE WHEN average_balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE average_balance END) AS max_average
    FROM rolling_balances
    WHERE days_in_window = 30 AND month > baseline_month
    GROUP BY customer_id, month
)
SELECT month, SUM(max_average) AS total_max_30_day_average_balance
FROM monthly_maxima
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 1000

Final SQL / answer

WITH seller_orders AS (
    SELECT i.seller_id,
           o.order_id,
           o.customer_id,
           SUM(i.price - i.freight_value) AS order_profit
    FROM main.olist_orders AS o
    JOIN main.olist_order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY i.seller_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id
),
five_star_reviews AS (
    SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS rating_count
    FROM main.olist_order_reviews
    WHERE review_score = 5
    GROUP BY order_id
),
seller_metrics AS (
    SELECT so.seller_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS customer_count,
           ROUND(SUM(so.order_profit), 2) AS profit,
           COUNT(*) AS order_count,
           SUM(COALESCE(r.rating_count, 0)) AS five_star_count
    FROM seller_orders AS so
    LEFT JOIN main.olist_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = so.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN five_star_reviews AS r ON r.order_id = so.order_id
    GROUP BY so.seller_id
),
achievements AS (
    SELECT 1 AS category_order, 'Most distinct customer unique IDs' AS achievement,
           seller_id, customer_count AS value
    FROM seller_metrics
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, 'Highest total profit', seller_id, profit
    FROM seller_metrics
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, 'Most distinct orders', seller_id, order_count
    FROM seller_metrics
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 4, 'Most 5-star ratings', seller_id, five_star_count
    FROM seller_metrics
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT category_order, achievement, seller_id, value,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY category_order
               ORDER BY value DESC, seller_id
           ) AS position
    FROM achievements
)
SELECT achievement, seller_id, value
FROM ranked
WHERE position = 1
ORDER BY category_order
LIMIT 4

Final SQL / answer

WITH seller_orders AS (
    SELECT i.seller_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id,
           SUM(i.price - i.freight_value) AS order_profit
    FROM main.olist_orders AS o
    JOIN main.olist_order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY i.seller_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id
),
five_star_ratings AS (
    SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS rating_count
    FROM main.olist_order_reviews
    WHERE review_score = 5
    GROUP BY order_id
),
seller_totals AS (
    SELECT s.seller_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS customers,
           ROUND(SUM(s.order_profit), 2) AS profit,
           COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS orders,
           SUM(COALESCE(r.rating_count, 0)) AS ratings
    FROM seller_orders AS s
    LEFT JOIN main.olist_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN five_star_ratings AS r ON r.order_id = s.order_id
    GROUP BY s.seller_id
),
achievements AS (
    SELECT 1 AS category, 'Most distinct customers' AS achievement,
           seller_id, customers AS value
    FROM seller_totals
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, 'Highest total profit', seller_id, profit FROM seller_totals
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, 'Most distinct orders', seller_id, orders FROM seller_totals
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 4, 'Most 5-star ratings', seller_id, ratings FROM seller_totals
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT achievements.*,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY value DESC) AS position
    FROM achievements
)
SELECT achievement, seller_id, value
FROM ranked
WHERE position = 1
ORDER BY category, seller_id
LIMIT 1000

Final SQL / answer

WITH reference_date(as_of) AS (
    SELECT date('now', '+09:00')
),
user_ages AS (
    SELECT
        u.user_id,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', r.as_of) AS INTEGER)
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', u.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
        - (strftime('%m-%d', r.as_of) < strftime('%m-%d', u.birth_date)) AS age
    FROM main.mst_users AS u
    CROSS JOIN reference_date AS r
),
age_categories(category_order, age_category) AS (
    VALUES (2, '20s'), (3, '30s'), (4, '40s'), (5, '50s'), (6, 'others')
)
SELECT
    c.age_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS user_count
FROM age_categories AS c
LEFT JOIN user_ages AS u
    ON c.category_order = CASE
        WHEN u.age BETWEEN 20 AND 59 THEN u.age / 10
        ELSE 6
    END
GROUP BY c.category_order, c.age_category
ORDER BY c.category_order
LIMIT 1000

WITH ages AS (
    SELECT user_id,
           strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', birth_date)
           - (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', birth_date)) AS age
    FROM main.mst_users
),
classified AS (
    SELECT user_id,
           CASE
               WHEN age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
               WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
               WHEN age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
               WHEN age BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
               ELSE 'others'
           END AS age_category
    FROM ages
),
categories(age_category) AS (
    VALUES ('20s'), ('30s'), ('40s'), ('50s'), ('others')
)
SELECT c.age_category, COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS user_count
FROM categories AS c
LEFT JOIN classified AS u ON u.age_category = c.age_category
GROUP BY c.age_category
ORDER BY c.age_category
LIMIT 5

Final SQL / answer

WITH team_matches AS (
    SELECT
        season,
        league_id,
        country_id,
        home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        home_team_goal AS goals_for,
        away_team_goal AS goals_against
    FROM main."Match"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        season,
        league_id,
        country_id,
        away_team_api_id,
        away_team_goal,
        home_team_goal
    FROM main."Match"
),
season_points AS (
    SELECT
        season,
        league_id,
        country_id,
        team_api_id,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN goals_for > goals_against THEN 3
            WHEN goals_for = goals_against THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) AS total_points
    FROM team_matches
    GROUP BY season, league_id, country_id, team_api_id
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT
        season,
        league_id,
        country_id,
        team_api_id,
        total_points,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY season
            ORDER BY total_points DESC
        ) AS points_rank
    FROM season_points
)
SELECT
    r.season,
    t.team_long_name AS team_name,
    l.name AS league,
    c.name AS country,
    r.total_points
FROM ranked_teams AS r
JOIN main.Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = r.team_api_id
JOIN main.League AS l ON l.id = r.league_id
JOIN main.Country AS c ON c.id = r.country_id
WHERE r.points_rank = 1
ORDER BY r.season, team_name, league, country
LIMIT 1000

Final SQL / answer

WITH team_matches AS (
    SELECT season, league_id, home_team_api_id AS team_id,
           home_team_goal AS goals_for, away_team_goal AS goals_against
    FROM main."Match"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT season, league_id, away_team_api_id AS team_id,
           away_team_goal AS goals_for, home_team_goal AS goals_against
    FROM main."Match"
),
season_totals AS (
    SELECT season, league_id, team_id,
           SUM(CASE
               WHEN goals_for > goals_against THEN 3
               WHEN goals_for = goals_against THEN 1
               ELSE 0
           END) AS total_points
    FROM team_matches
    GROUP BY season, league_id, team_id
),
standings AS (
    SELECT season, league_id, team_id, total_points,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY season ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS season_rank
    FROM season_totals
)
SELECT s.season, t.team_long_name AS team_name, l.name AS league,
       c.name AS country, s.total_points
FROM standings AS s
JOIN main.Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = s.team_id
JOIN main.League AS l ON l.id = s.league_id
JOIN main.Country AS c ON c.id = l.country_id
WHERE s.season_rank = 1
ORDER BY s.season, team_name
LIMIT 1000

Final SQL / answer

WITH monthly_net AS (
    SELECT
        tx.customer_id,
        DATE(tx.txn_date, 'start of month') AS month_start,
        SUM(CASE tx.txn_type
            WHEN 'deposit' THEN tx.txn_amount
            WHEN 'withdrawal' THEN -tx.txn_amount
        END) AS net_amount
    FROM main.customer_transactions AS tx
    WHERE tx.txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
    GROUP BY tx.customer_id, DATE(tx.txn_date, 'start of month')
),
monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        SUM(net_amount) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id
            ORDER BY month_start
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS closing_balance,
        net_amount
    FROM monthly_net
),
latest_balances AS (
    SELECT
        closing_balance,
        closing_balance - net_amount AS prior_month_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start DESC
        ) AS month_rank
    FROM monthly_balances
),
customer_growth AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN prior_month_balance = 0 THEN closing_balance * 100.0
            ELSE (closing_balance - prior_month_balance) * 100.0 / prior_month_balance
        END AS growth_rate
    FROM latest_balances
    WHERE month_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 END)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage_of_customers
FROM customer_growth
LIMIT 1

Final SQL / answer

WITH monthly_nets AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        DATE(txn_date, 'start of month') AS month_start,
        SUM(CASE txn_type
            WHEN 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
            WHEN 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
        END) AS net_amount
    FROM main.customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
    GROUP BY customer_id, month_start
),
monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        SUM(net_amount) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id
            ORDER BY month_start
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS closing_balance
    FROM monthly_nets
),
balance_comparisons AS (
    SELECT
        closing_balance,
        LAG(closing_balance, 1, 0) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start
        ) AS prior_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start DESC
        ) AS recency
    FROM monthly_balances
),
latest_growth AS (
    SELECT CASE
        WHEN prior_balance = 0 THEN 100.0 * closing_balance
        ELSE 100.0 * (closing_balance - prior_balance) / prior_balance
    END AS growth_rate
    FROM balance_comparisons
    WHERE recency = 1
)
SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 END)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage_of_customers
FROM latest_growth
LIMIT 1

Final SQL / answer

WITH page_visits AS (
    SELECT session,
           path,
           stamp,
           MIN(stamp) OVER (PARTITION BY session) AS first_stamp,
           MAX(stamp) OVER (PARTITION BY session) AS last_stamp
    FROM main.activity_log
    WHERE action = 'view'
)
SELECT path,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
           WHEN stamp = first_stamp OR stamp = last_stamp THEN session
       END) AS session_count
FROM page_visits
WHERE path IS NOT NULL AND path <> ''
GROUP BY path
ORDER BY path
LIMIT -1

Final SQL / answer

WITH page_visits AS (
    SELECT
        path,
        session,
        stamp,
        MIN(stamp) OVER (PARTITION BY session) AS first_stamp,
        MAX(stamp) OVER (PARTITION BY session) AS last_stamp
    FROM main.activity_log
    WHERE action = 'view'
)
SELECT
    path,
    COUNT(DISTINCT session) FILTER (
        WHERE stamp = first_stamp OR stamp = last_stamp
    ) AS session_count
FROM page_visits
GROUP BY path
ORDER BY path
LIMIT 1000

Final SQL / answer

WITH run_entries AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, runs_scored AS runs
    FROM main.batsman_scored
    UNION ALL
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, extra_runs AS runs
    FROM main.extra_runs
),
over_totals AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, SUM(runs) AS total_runs
    FROM run_entries
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
),
over_bowlers AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id,
           JSON_GROUP_ARRAY(DISTINCT bowler ORDER BY bowler) AS bowler_ids
    FROM main.ball_by_ball
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
),
ranked_overs AS (
    -- Include every match with recorded overs and take the earliest over among ties.
    SELECT b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id, b.bowler_ids,
           COALESCE(t.total_runs, 0) AS total_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY b.match_id
               ORDER BY COALESCE(t.total_runs, 0) DESC, b.innings_no, b.over_id
           ) AS over_rank
    FROM over_bowlers AS b
    LEFT JOIN over_totals AS t USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id)
)
SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, total_runs, bowler_ids,
       AVG(total_runs) OVER () AS avg_highest_over_runs
FROM ranked_overs
WHERE over_rank = 1
ORDER BY match_id
LIMIT -1

Final SQL / answer

WITH scoring AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, runs_scored AS runs
    FROM main.batsman_scored
    UNION ALL
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, extra_runs AS runs
    FROM main.extra_runs
),
over_totals AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, SUM(runs) AS total_runs
    FROM scoring
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
),
ranked_overs AS (
    SELECT over_totals.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY match_id
               ORDER BY total_runs DESC, innings_no, over_id
           ) AS over_rank
    FROM over_totals
)
SELECT r.match_id,
       r.innings_no,
       r.over_id,
       r.total_runs,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT b.bowler ORDER BY b.bowler) AS bowler_ids,
       AVG(r.total_runs) OVER () AS average_highest_over_runs
FROM ranked_overs AS r
LEFT JOIN main.ball_by_ball AS b USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id)
WHERE r.over_rank = 1
GROUP BY r.match_id, r.innings_no, r.over_id, r.total_runs
ORDER BY r.match_id
LIMIT 1000

      "sql": "WITH scores AS (\n    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, runs_scored AS runs FROM main.batsman_scored\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, extra_runs FROM main.extra_runs\n), ranked AS (\n    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, SUM(runs) AS total_runs,\n           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY SUM(runs) DESC, innings_no, over_id) AS position\n    FROM scores GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id\n), selected AS (\n    SELECT r.match_id, r.total_runs, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bowler) AS bowler_count\n    FROM ranked r LEFT JOIN main.ball_by_ball b USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id)\n    WHERE r.position = 1 GROUP BY r.match_id, r.total_runs\n)\nSELECT sqlite_version() AS version, COUNT(*) AS matches, AVG(total_runs) AS avg_runs,\n       SUM(bowler_count = 0) AS no_bowler, SUM(bowler_count > 1) AS shared_overs\nFROM selected"
